name: The pitch measure page can hold 0 degrees to check the gauge
step: Check the Setup Wizard pitch measure page
rationale: Issue #2706: the Setup Wizard's pitch measure pages held 9 degrees from the moment they opened, and nothing on the page went back to 0. A pilot could not compare 0 and 9 at the gauge, or check after a calibration that 0 still reads 0, and a wrong zero makes the calibration wrong. The measure pages now have a check row that holds 0 degrees, and a row back to 9. At 0 degrees the page shows only that row, since Calibrate counts from 9 degrees. The harness drives the real setup_wizard_pitch.lua with the UI and the wizard context stubbed, records the holds the page asks for, and checks that the collective measure page holds 9 degrees at the start, that the check row holds 0 degrees and offers only the way back, that the way back holds 9 degrees with Calibrate again, and that the fine page still holds 9 degrees. Its self-test removes the check row and requires that there is no way to 0 degrees. On the code before the fix the check row is missing and the harness fails. Issue #2709: the cyclic measure page held pitch at 9 degrees, so the blades had to be turned left and right, and the head moved between the collective and the cyclic reading. The cyclic page now holds roll at 9 degrees with the blades turned left and right, as the Configurator holds them (review of PR #2776); its text says so. The harness checks that the cyclic page holds roll and not pitch (5a, 5b). The holding of roll is a design change that has not been measured on a model with a gauge.
